caption: A close indoor portrait of a woman in a black drape, looking up toward the left of the frame with pursed lips. Bright, even light catches her face, with framed abstract art behind her.

A full-length living-room mirror selfie of a woman in a black graphic T-shirt and turquoise swim bottoms, standing side-on with her knees bent and a heel lifted. Her phone and hair hide most of her face, with white blinds and a pale pink sofa behind her.

A thigh-up indoor fitness portrait of a woman in a black bikini top and patterned posing bottoms, smiling at the camera with one arm flexed and the other hand on her hip. Ceiling beams and a gym ring are visible behind her, with black bands above and below the image.

A wide bathroom mirror selfie of a woman in a black bikini top and posing bottoms, turned sideways with one knee raised and a phone covering her face. A white sink fills the foreground, with a red light and a circular fixture reflected in the dark room.

A tilted bathroom mirror selfie of a woman in a black bikini top and posing bottoms, with a knee raised and her free arm bent up beside her head. Her phone covers her face, and the frame includes a white sink, dark walls and a small red light.

A close chest-up selfie of a woman with loose dark hair smiling with teeth visible, wearing a tan jacket fastened at the collar and a chain strap over one shoulder. A dark overhang frames the outdoor daylight behind her.

A tilted, wide gym mirror selfie of a woman in a light graphic crop top and gray leggings, standing with her feet apart and holding her phone near her face. Weights, benches and tall dark windows surround her reflection.

A high-angle gym selfie framed from the mouth to the upper legs, with a black sports bra and gray leggings. One arm extends toward the camera and the other hand rests across the upper chest, with dark windows behind her.

A tilted, high-angle gym selfie of a woman in a black sports bra and gray leggings, with the frame cutting off her eyes. Her free hand rests across the front of the top, and window frames run diagonally behind her.
A tilted, high-angle gym selfie of a woman in a black sports bra and gray leggings beside a padded exercise bench. The top edge cuts through her face, and weight machines fill the background.

A high-angle torso selfie in a gym, showing a woman in a black twisted-front sports bra and gray leggings, with one hand at her hip. Most of her face is above the frame, and weight equipment stands against dark windows.

A close selfie of a woman with loose dark hair holding up a peace sign under red indoor lighting. She has a small closed-mouth smile, and hair covers part of her face. Ceiling beams and hanging reflective fixtures are behind her.

A close selfie of a woman with loose dark hair holding up a peace sign under red indoor lighting. She has a small closed-mouth smile, and hair covers part of her face. Ceiling beams and hanging reflective fixtures are behind her.

A close selfie of a woman smiling with teeth visible and holding up a peace sign. Red indoor light falls across her face and hands, long dark hair covers part of her face, and shiny fixtures hang behind her.

A close selfie of a woman smiling with teeth visible and holding up a peace sign. Red indoor light falls across her face and hands, long dark hair covers part of her face, and shiny fixtures hang behind her.

A tilted indoor portrait of a woman in a dark textured jacket, leaning forward with her forearms together and giving a small closed-mouth smile. Red light catches her face and hands, with diagonal ceiling slats behind her.

A tilted indoor portrait of a woman in a dark textured jacket, leaning forward with her forearms together and giving a small closed-mouth smile. Red light catches her face and hands, with diagonal ceiling slats behind her.

A full-length bedroom mirror selfie of a woman in a short black outfit and white trainers, with a small light-colored shoulder bag. She holds a phone beside her face and stands with one knee bent beside a bed with pale bedding.

A distant full-length reflection in a narrow door mirror, showing a woman in a light top, gray flared trousers and white trainers. She stands sideways with one knee lifted slightly and her free hand extended, with a tiled room beyond.

A distant full-length mirror selfie in a narrow door mirror. A woman in a light top, gray flared trousers and white trainers holds a phone beside her face and bends one knee, with her free arm lowered in a pale tiled room.

A high-angle selfie of a woman reclining on a blue chair in a dark sparkly bikini top, smiling with teeth visible and touching a fingertip to her mouth. She wears dark eye makeup and a pale wristband, with patterned upholstery behind her.

A high-angle selfie of a woman reclining on a blue chair in a dark sparkly bikini top. She grins and raises an open hand with curled fingers toward the camera, with dark eye makeup and a pale wristband visible.
A sideways close selfie of a woman with dark eye makeup, glossy pink lips and long dark hair spread over blue upholstery. Part of a sparkly black bikini top is visible at the edge.

A close selfie of a woman with long straight dark hair and a dark textured jacket seated beside an airplane window. She looks into the camera with pursed lips as directional window light falls across her face.
A chest-up car selfie of a woman in a brown textured jacket with long dark hair, smiling at the camera with her head slightly tilted. Side-window daylight illuminates her face.
A close car selfie of a woman in a brown textured jacket, smiling with long dark hair over her shoulders. Warm sunlight enters at the right edge and catches the ends of her hair.

A wide full-length gym mirror selfie of a woman in a dark patterned sports bra and black trousers inside a squat rack. Her free arm reaches to one upright, with stacked weight plates and a wooden lifting platform around her.

A centered full-length gym mirror selfie of a woman standing with her legs crossed in a squat rack, wearing a dark sports bra and black trousers. She reaches outward to the rack while holding her phone beside her face.

A tilted full-length gym mirror selfie of a woman in a patterned sports bra and black trousers, flexing her free arm with her legs nearly straight. Weight plates, two rack uprights and a wooden floor panel frame her reflection.

A tilted full-length gym mirror selfie of a woman in a patterned sports bra and black trousers, with one elbow raised in a flex and her weight shifted to one leg. A phone sits beside her face, with rack uprights and weight plates behind her.

A wide, tilted gym mirror selfie of a woman flexing one arm in a weight rack, wearing a patterned sports bra and black trousers. She holds a phone near her face, with her legs nearly straight on the wooden platform.

A tilted full-length gym mirror selfie of a woman flexing one arm, wearing a dark sports bra and black trousers. One knee bends inward in front of the other leg, and the squat rack and weight plates fill the background.

A tilted full-length gym mirror selfie of a woman in a dark sports bra and black trousers reaching diagonally up to the rack with her free hand. She holds a phone at face height, with the wooden lifting platform below.

A full-length rear view of a woman at the shoreline in a pink crop top and pink-and-white swim bottoms. She faces the water with one knee relaxed and long dark hair down her back, against an orange sunset.

A wide horizontal beach portrait of a woman in a white bikini seated on sand at dusk, leaning back on her hands with one knee raised and her chin lifted. Bright light falls on her against the dark sea and a line of distant shore lights.

A full-length beach portrait of a woman in a pink cherry-print crop top and pink-and-white swim bottoms, balancing on one leg with the other knee turned inward and her head tilted toward the camera. Waves and a soft orange horizon sit behind her.

A wide horizontal beach photo of a woman in a white bikini with her wrists crossed overhead and one knee bent outward on a slope of sand. She is brightly lit against an orange horizon and casts a hard shadow beside the shoreline.

A vertical full-length beach photo of a woman in a white bikini turning diagonally toward the camera with both arms raised and her wrists crossed. Direct light casts a long shadow on the sand beneath an orange dusk sky.

A thigh-up beach portrait of a woman in a pink cherry-print crop top and white skirt. She turns her shoulders sideways and smiles at the camera, with long dark hair, softly blurred surf and a pale sunset behind her.

A low-angle full-length beach portrait of a woman in a pink graphic crop top and pink-and-white swim bottoms, chin lifted in profile. One hand is at her hip and the other holds a lock of hair against the purple and orange evening sky.

A wide horizontal beach photo of a woman in a white bikini reclining on her forearms, with one leg extended and the other knee raised. The lit sand and subject stand out against dark surf and distant lights at dusk.

A full-length portrait of a smiling woman at the beach in a pink crop top and white skirt, balancing with one knee lifted and both hands near her waistband. The sky is pale orange above softly blurred waves.

A centered full-length portrait of a woman in a white bikini standing barefoot on a sloped beach, with one hand near her waist and the other on her thigh. She stands in direct light with the orange horizon and dark surf behind her.

A full-length beach photo at dusk of a woman in a white bikini balancing on one leg, with the other bent and crossing in front. Both arms hang loosely, with a hard shadow on the sand and the sea behind her.

A knee-up shoreline portrait of a woman in a pink graphic crop top and white skirt, standing with her back partly toward the camera and looking over her shoulder. Long dark hair hangs down her back, with white surf and pale sunset colors behind her.

A close vertical beach portrait of a woman in a pink cherry-print crop top and pink swim bottoms. She faces the camera with her head tilted and one knee raised across the other leg, with dark hair forward and the sandy shore out of focus.

A full-length beach portrait of a woman in a white bikini, with her elbows bent overhead and her wrists crossed above her head. Her body leans sideways, with a pronounced shadow on the sand and a strip of dusk lights beyond.

A thigh-up rear three-quarter beach portrait of a woman in a pink crop top and pink-and-white swim bottoms. Her face is visible in downward profile, with long dark hair over her back and blurred waves against an orange horizon.

A wide horizontal view of a woman in a white bikini standing in a staggered stance near the water, with one knee raised on the sand and her head tilted down to the side. Direct light creates a strong shadow along the shore at dusk.

A horizontal beach portrait of a woman in a white bikini with bent knees, leaning back on both hands and turning her face toward the camera. Her long hair hangs down behind her against an orange sky, dark surf and distant lights.

A thigh-up portrait of a woman smiling at the camera in a pink cherry-print crop top and white skirt, with her body slightly sideways and one knee forward. Soft sunset light and blurred white surf frame her.

A woman in a pink crop top and pink-and-white swim bottoms kneels side-on in the sand, looking back with a small smile and holding a lock of her long dark hair in one hand. The beach and water run into an orange-purple sunset.

A horizontal beach photo from above of a woman in a white bikini lying on the sand, one leg extended and the other knee up. Her head is turned away beside spread-out dark hair, with bright light, footprints and a sharply defined shadow around her.

A vertical beach portrait of a woman in a pink cherry-print crop top and white skirt smiling with teeth visible. She balances with one knee bent across the other leg and both hands near her waist, backed by softly blurred surf and a pale orange sky.

A full-length beach fitness pose of a woman in a white bikini with one hand at her waist, one knee bent and her head turned toward the camera. Direct light creates a dark shadow on the sand with the orange horizon and waves behind her.

A vertical full-length photo of a woman in a white bikini standing sideways at dusk, her head tilted toward the camera and one hand lifted over her hair. A long shadow falls toward the dark shoreline.

A full-length side view of a woman in a pink crop top and pink-and-white swim bottoms balancing on one leg with the other knee raised. She stretches both arms overhead as the shoreline recedes under a pale orange sunset.

A low-angle full-length rear three-quarter portrait of a woman in a pink crop top and pink-and-white swim bottoms, with one heel raised and her face turned sideways in profile. Her long dark hair falls down her back against a purple and orange sky.

A centered full-length beach photo of a woman in a white bikini, facing the camera with both arms straight overhead and her hands clasped. She is lit from the front against dark surf and a deep orange sunset.

A wide horizontal photo of a woman in a white bikini standing with one foot higher on the sand and one hand on her hip. Her torso turns toward the camera under strong direct light, with waves and shore lights behind her.

A horizontal beach photo of a woman in a white bikini sitting back on her hands, with one knee raised and her head tipped back. Long dark hair hangs toward the sand, with dark surf and a line of shore lights under an orange sky.

A woman in a pink crop top and pink-and-white swim bottoms kneels side-on in the sand, with both hands near her thighs and her face turned back toward the camera. Her dark hair hangs down her back against an orange and purple sunset.

A high-angle horizontal beach photo of a woman in a white bikini reclining on the sand in direct light. One knee is raised, her face turns toward the camera, and her hair and shadow extend across the textured sand.

A full-length vertical beach portrait of a woman in a white bikini standing in a three-quarter pose, with one hand on her hip and one knee bent. Direct light picks her out against dark water, damp sand and an orange dusk sky.

A vertical full-length beach portrait of a woman in a white bikini standing side-on and turning her head back with one hand close to her hair. Orange dusk and distant shoreline lights frame her, with a long shadow across the sand.

A full-length beach portrait of a woman in a pink graphic crop top and pink-and-white swim bottoms, smiling with her head tilted. She balances with one knee lifted across her standing leg, one hand at her waist, and sunset surf behind her.

A wide horizontal view of a woman in a white bikini holding her hands together overhead, standing sideways with her ankles close together. The breaking surf curves past her, and direct light casts a long shadow beneath an orange sky.

A horizontal full-length beach portrait of a woman in a white bikini, with one hand at her hip and the other near the front of her waist. One foot sits higher on the sand and she turns toward the camera against deep orange dusk.

A low-angle rear view of a woman in a pink crop top and pink-and-white swim bottoms, balancing with one knee bent and an arm raised to the back of her head. Long dark hair trails behind her beneath a purple-orange sky.

A horizontal beach portrait of a woman in a white bikini leaning back on both hands with her knees bent, looking back toward the camera. Direct light illuminates her and the sand, with dark waves and a line of distant lights at dusk.

A wide horizontal beach portrait of a woman in a white bikini reclining on her forearms, with one leg extended across the sand and one knee raised. She turns her head toward the camera, with a sliver of dark water and distant lights behind her.

A vertical thigh-up beach portrait of a woman in a white bikini, turned at an angle with one hand at her waist and one knee bent. She looks toward the camera, with strongly lit dark hair and a blurred orange horizon behind her.

A wide horizontal beach photo of a woman in a white bikini standing sideways with her ankles close and one hand lifted near her head. She is framed by dark surf, distant lights and an orange sky, with a long shadow in the sand.

A full-length portrait of a woman in a white bikini standing barefoot on the beach with her feet close together, both arms down and her head slightly tilted. Strong direct light contrasts with the dark waves and orange horizon.

A low-angle full-length side and rear view of a woman in a pink crop top and pink-and-white swim bottoms, standing tall with her hands near her waist. Her profile is outlined against a purple sky and a bright orange strip at the horizon.

A wide horizontal beach photo of a woman in a white bikini, smiling toward the camera with one hand on her hip and the other on her thigh. One knee is bent uphill on the sand, with dark surf and an orange dusk sky behind her.

A wide horizontal beach portrait of a woman in a pink crop top and pink-and-white swim bottoms kneeling on sand, one arm curved over her head and the other hand braced beside her. Waves and an orange sunset fill the background.

A full-length rear three-quarter beach portrait of a woman in a white bikini looking back over her shoulder, with one hand at her waist and one knee relaxed. Bright light catches her against black sand shadows, dark waves and a vivid orange horizon.

A thigh-up rear three-quarter beach portrait of a woman in a pink crop top and pink-and-white swim bottoms, looking downward in profile with one hand at her waist. Her long dark hair falls down her back with blurred surf behind her.

A low-angle full-length beach portrait of a woman in a pink crop top and pink-and-white swim bottoms, standing with her feet apart and one hand behind her head. The purple-orange dusk sky takes up most of the background.

A vertical full-length beach photo of a woman in a white bikini standing in a rear three-quarter pose, with one heel lifted and her head turned back toward the camera. Direct light casts a long shadow across the sand toward the dark surf.

A wide horizontal beach portrait of a woman in a white bikini, standing sideways on the shoreline with her arms overhead and her knees slightly bent. A long shadow stretches across the sand with dark water and orange dusk beyond.

A low-angle full-length beach portrait of a woman in a pink crop top and pink-and-white swim bottoms, standing with a staggered stance and both arms extended overhead. The sky fades from orange to purple above the shore.

A close indoor selfie of a woman in a light textured top with gold jewelry, holding a large stemmed glass with a dark drink beside her face. She looks into the camera with a closed-mouth smile under soft indoor light.

A wide bathroom mirror selfie of a woman in a white printed crop top and patterned posing bottoms, standing facing the mirror with her phone at eye level. Strong side light falls on the dark wall beside the sink and a round fixture.

A vertical indoor fitness pose of a woman in a white printed crop top, pale posing bottoms and clear heels. She balances side-on with one knee raised, both hands near that knee, and her face turned toward the camera. Black bands border the top and bottom.

A vertical indoor fitness pose of a smiling woman in a white printed crop top and pale posing bottoms, with one knee raised and both hands behind her head. A white doorway and dark walls are visible, with black bands above and below.

A full-length mirror selfie of a woman in a red top, dark posing bottoms and black boots, turning toward the phone while raising one knee. A bright vertical light strip frames her reflection against a dark door.

A full-length living-room mirror selfie of a woman in a patterned bikini top, black flared skirt and light trainers, posing with one knee lifted. Her phone partly covers one eye, with pale blinds and a pink tufted sofa behind her.

A wide full-length mirror selfie of a woman in a patterned bikini top, black flared skirt and white trainers. She stands with one foot lifted in front of a pink sofa, holding the phone beside her face in daylight from white blinds.

A tilted living-room mirror selfie of a woman in a patterned bikini top, black flared skirt and white trainers, with one knee lifted and her free arm flexed. Her phone covers much of her face. A pink tufted sofa and window blinds fill the background.

A tilted wardrobe-mirror photo of a woman reclining sideways on a bed in a pink top, with her head propped up and her phone covering much of her face. A closed curtain is lit along the top and a floor fan appears below the mirror.

A tilted overhead selfie of a woman reclining on an outdoor lounger in a beige textured bikini top and pink bottoms. She wears dark sunglasses and holds one hand against the frames, with bright sunlight across the lounger and one knee raised.

A tilted overhead selfie of a woman reclining in direct sunlight on an outdoor lounger, wearing dark sunglasses, a beige bikini top and pink bottoms. One knee is raised, and two fingers of her free hand rest near her face.

A full-length living-room mirror selfie of a woman in a cropped black graphic T-shirt and turquoise posing bottoms, standing side-on with one foot pointed back. Her phone partly covers her face, with white blinds, a pale sofa and a tripod in the room.

A close indoor selfie of a smiling woman in a black bikini top, with long straight dark hair falling across one eye and both shoulders. A wall-mounted screen and dark shelving sit behind her in a bright room.

A round-mirror selfie of a woman in a dark red halter one-piece with a keyhole neckline, holding her phone above eye level. Warm mirror lighting illuminates her, with dark blinds, a sofa and a stone-textured wall in the reflection.

A tilted, high-angle selfie of a woman in a dark red halter one-piece with a keyhole neckline and side cutouts. She looks toward the camera with a slight closed-mouth smile, with white flowers and a dark screen behind her.

A vertical full-length beach photo of a woman in a white bikini doing a backbend on the sand, supported on both hands with one bent leg raised. Her hair falls toward the sand and hides her face, with distant lights below a dusky sky.
